name: Warrior of the Mystic Arts

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-1-character-options.

summary: A monk who combines martial training with Sorcerer spells.

feature.name: Spellcasting
feature.summary: Wisdom-based Sorcerer spellcasting with an Arcane Focus. Start with two cantrips and three prepared level 1 spells; learn a third cantrip at Monk level 10. Spell slots and prepared spells follow the third-caster table. Replace one cantrip and one prepared spell on gaining a Monk level.
feature.text: Wisdom-based Sorcerer spellcasting with an Arcane Focus. Start with two cantrips and three prepared level 1 spells; learn a third cantrip at Monk level 10. Spell slots and prepared spells follow the third-caster table. Replace one cantrip and one prepared spell on gaining a Monk level.

feature.name: Mystic Fighting Style
feature.summary: Replace one Unarmed Strike in your Attack action with a Sorcerer cantrip that takes an action.
feature.text: Replace one Unarmed Strike in your Attack action with a Sorcerer cantrip that takes an action.

feature.name: Mystic Focus
feature.summary: Spend a slot without an action to recover Focus Points equal to its level. After a Short Rest or Uncanny Metabolism, spend Focus Points to recover one slot: level 1 costs 2 (Monk 6+), level 2 costs 3 (Monk 7+), level 3 costs 5 (Monk 13+), level 4 costs 6 (Monk 19+).
feature.text: Spend a slot without an action to recover Focus Points equal to its level. After a Short Rest or Uncanny Metabolism, spend Focus Points to recover one slot: level 1 costs 2 (Monk 6+), level 2 costs 3 (Monk 7+), level 3 costs 5 (Monk 13+), level 4 costs 6 (Monk 19+).

feature.name: Focused Strike
feature.summary: A Stunning Strike target has Disadvantage on saves against your spells until your next turn starts, regardless of its Stunning Strike save result.
feature.text: A Stunning Strike target has Disadvantage on saves against your spells until your next turn starts, regardless of its Stunning Strike save result.

feature.name: Improved Mystic Fighting Style
feature.summary: Replace two Flurry of Blows strikes with one level 1 or 2 Sorcerer spell that normally takes an action, casting within the same Bonus Action.
feature.text: Replace two Flurry of Blows strikes with one level 1 or 2 Sorcerer spell that normally takes an action, casting within the same Bonus Action.
